definition.simple: The price of borrowing money, shown as a percentage per year.
definition.balanced: A [[central-bank]] sets a short-term policy rate. Other rates follow it. In forex, the rate gap between two currencies affects [[swap]] costs and can shape demand for a currency. Expectations about future rates often matter as much as today's rate.

example: Hypothetical: a fictional central bank raises its policy rate from 3.00% to 3.25%.
